Messages.Author: Jesper
Messages.Body:
Well since I co-created that deck and played it in the first days I just answer here.

The point was to exchange your deck for a gazillion pool and the following setup.

Saulot with a Repulsion and an Enkil Cog
Enkidu
Hektor with a talbots chainsaw
Dragon Bound in play
Monestary of shadows in play
Waste mgmt. Op. In play
Jake washington

And in your ashheap a psych, renewed vigor and freakdrives, and see where it would bring you.

/Jesper
